description:
« Avant Parcoursup, ça marchait » : Marine Tondelier critique la plateforme d'orientation des lycéens 🎓🐱 Pour 🐱 ou contre ❌ ? Un émoji suffit 👇
#actu #politique #parcoursup #tondelier #ecologie

segments.text: Avant Parcoursup, ça marchait, dit Marine Tondelier.
segments.bg: a sunny old university courtyard with stone buildings and green trees, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: rushing across the courtyard carrying a towering wobbling stack of paper application folders
segments.accessory: a small green backpack and round glasses

segments.text: La candidate critique la plateforme d'orientation des lycéens.
segments.bg: a bright school corridor with lockers and a corkboard covered with colorful pins, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: pinning sheets of paper to a corkboard one after another, tongue out in concentration
segments.accessory: round glasses and a small green backpack

segments.text: Une députée écologiste réclame son abrogation.
segments.bg: a grand old parliament hall with green benches and a tall wooden desk, warm light, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: standing on the desk and raising one paw high to vote while sheets of paper fall around
segments.accessory: a green sash across its chest

segments.text: Flocon, lui, n'a jamais fini son dossier.
segments.bg: a cozy study room with a wooden desk, a lamp and a tall stack of folders, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: slumped over a half-finished form, one paw holding a pen, yawning widely
segments.accessory: round glasses and a green cardigan

segments.text: Une question de dossier, mais surtout d'avenir pour les lycéens.
segments.bg: a sunny square with a fountain and tall trees in front of a historic building, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: walking forward slowly with a thoughtful face, holding a small folder under one arm

segments.text: Tu es pour ? Mets un chat. Contre ? Mets une croix.
segments.bg: a stage with a warm spotlight and a red velvet curtain, no people, no text, no writing
segments.action: standing on the stage with both paws open, looking straight at the camera as if asking a question
